fact: Car 5 was released into the path of Car 87 on the way to the reconnaissance laps.
offence: Breach of Article B1.6.2a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 5 was released from its garage shortly after Car 87 and blocked Car 87 from proceeding to the end of the pit lane in the fast lane. This constitutes an unsafe release, although not dangerous in nature. Due to the proximity of both garages and the very limited time between both releases, the reaction time for the team to prevent the unsafe release was extremely short. Taking all this into account in mitigation, the Stewards determine that a Warning to the team is appropriate.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 5 Unsafe Release
to: The Team Manager, Audi Revolut F1 Team
